title: Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.24115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. translated_title: 具身图：一种面向长时程任务的关系型世界模型
translated_abstract: 具身与网络环境中的长时程任务涉及较长的决策序列和延迟反馈，这使得准确的规划对成功至关重要。世界模型通过学习潜在动力学进行基于想象的规划来解决这一问题。然而，现有方法仅依赖稠密的像素级观测，这迫使模型吸收冗余信息，同时忽略了任务相关实体之间的关系。因此，微小的误差可能在长时程的想象推演中不断累积，并逐渐破坏预测的可靠性。在本文中，我们探索了在稀疏状态抽象上进行想象的世界模型，这带来了两个关键挑战：1）如何去除冗余信息并形成紧凑的状态抽象；2）如何融入关系结构以学习可靠的长时程动力学。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Embodied Graph，一种支持结构化动力学建模的关系型状态抽象……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Embodied Graph，一种基于稀疏关系状态抽象的关系型世界模型，通过去除冗余像素信息并建模任务实体间的关系结构，实现可靠的长时程想象规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Embodied Graph, a relational world model that imagines over sparse relational state abstractions, removing redundant pixel-level information and incorporating relational structure among task-relevant entities to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics for planning.
